title: Abramelin, the hermit of Luxor in The Book of Abramelin

tellings.quote: Abramelon is essentially a uh, a desert hermit in Egypt around Luxor.

plain: The Book of Abramelin centres on Abramelin, who Matthew Brown, a guest billed as a Pentagon whistleblower, describes as "essentially a desert hermit in Egypt around Luxor." Brown gives this as his own summary of the book, without naming any other source, and brings it up because he links the book's teachings to his larger account of contact with other beings.
